import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        long[][] p = new long[6][6];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = (val * modPow(100, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = n; i <= 5; ++i) {
            p[i][i] = 1;
        }
        
        List<Integer> combos = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int m = 0; m < 64; ++m) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(m) == 3) {
                combos.add(m);
            }
        }
        
        long[] f = new long[1 << 20];
        long[] g = new long[1 << 20];
        
        // First part: columns 0-2
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long prod = 1;
            int bitIdx = 0;
            
            for (int r = 0; r < 6; ++r) {
                for (int c = 0; c <= 2; ++c) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << bitIdx)) != 0) {
                        grid[r][c] = true;
                        prod = (prod * p[r][c]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = (prod * ((1 - p[r][c] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    }
                    ++bitIdx;
                }
            }
            
            int combMask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < combos.size(); ++i) {
                int combo = combos.get(i);
                int[] indices = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                    if ((combo & (1 << k)) != 0) indices[cnt++] = k;
                }
                
                if ((grid[indices[0]][0] && grid[indices[1]][1] && grid[indices[2]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[0]][0] && grid[indices[2]][1] && grid[indices[1]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][0] && grid[indices[0]][1] && grid[indices[2]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][0] && grid[indices[2]][1] && grid[indices[0]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][0] && grid[indices[0]][1] && grid[indices[1]][2]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][0] && grid[indices[1]][1] && grid[indices[0]][2])) {
                    combMask |= (1 << i);
                }
            }
            
            f[combMask] = (f[combMask] + prod) % MOD;
        }
        
        // Second part: columns 3-5
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            boolean[][] grid = new boolean[6][6];
            long prod = 1;
            int bitIdx = 0;
            
            for (int r = 0; r < 6; ++r) {
                for (int c = 3; c <= 5; ++c) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << bitIdx)) != 0) {
                        grid[r][c] = true;
                        prod = (prod * p[r][c]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        prod = (prod * ((1 - p[r][c] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    }
                    ++bitIdx;
                }
            }
            
            int combMask = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < combos.size(); ++i) {
                int combo = combos.get(i);
                int complement = combo ^ 63;
                int[] indices = new int[3];
                int cnt = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                    if ((complement & (1 << k)) != 0) indices[cnt++] = k;
                }
                
                if ((grid[indices[0]][3] && grid[indices[1]][4] && grid[indices[2]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[0]][3] && grid[indices[2]][4] && grid[indices[1]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][3] && grid[indices[0]][4] && grid[indices[2]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[1]][3] && grid[indices[2]][4] && grid[indices[0]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][3] && grid[indices[0]][4] && grid[indices[1]][5]) ||
                    (grid[indices[2]][3] && grid[indices[1]][4] && grid[indices[0]][5])) {
                    combMask |= (1 << i);
                }
            }
            
            g[combMask] = (g[combMask] + prod) % MOD;
        }
        
        // Sum over subsets for g
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 20; ++bit) {
            for (int mask = (1 << 20) - 1; mask >= 0; --mask) {
                if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                    g[mask] = (g[mask] + g[mask ^ (1 << bit)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); ++mask) {
            ans = (ans + f[mask] * g[((1 << 20) - 1) ^ mask]) % MOD;
        }
        
        System.out.println((1 - ans + MOD) % MOD);
    }
}
